questions: Often called the 'Godmother of Punk,' she co-founded the Runaways at 15 and, after every label rejected her debut, started her own — Blackheart Records — who is it?
Joan Jett: American singer and guitarist (born 1958)

This Swedish politician became leader of the Moderate Party in 2017 after Anna Kinberg Batra resigned, and has served as Prime Minister since forming a minority government following the 2022 election — who is he?
Ulf Kristersson (born 29 December 1963) is a Swedish politician who has served as Prime Minister of Sweden since October 2022 and as leader of the Moderate Party since 2017.
After leading Stanford to the 2019 national title, this forward became the first overall pick in the 2020 NWSL draft and later won NWSL MVP — who is she?

Sophia Wilson (ne Smith; born August 10, 2000) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a forward for Portland Thorns FC of the National Women's Soccer League (NWSL) and the United States national team.
Part of the same species as cabbage and broccoli, this loose-leafed member of the 'kale group' has been grown for its big, dark-green leaves since classical antiquity — what is it?
Collard (plant) is a group of loose-leafed cultivars of Brassica oleracea (the same species as many common vegetables, including cabbage and broccoli).
Home to Ashoka's Lion Capital — now India's state emblem — this town near Varanasi is where the Buddha delivered his first sermon after enlightenment — which town?
Sarnath: Buddhist pilgrimage site in India.
